_comment: This file intentionally contains NO real secrets. Every value below is either a safe production default or a placeholder that MUST be overridden by an environment variable at deploy time (see docker-compose.yml / .env.production.example). ASP.NET Core's configuration system reads environment variables named Section__Key (double underscore) automatically, taking precedence over this file.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Override with the ConnectionStrings__Postgres environment variable.

Cors._comment: This empty array is NOT itself a functioning override — ASP.NET Core's config layering does not let an empty array here clear a non-empty one set in the base appsettings.json. The Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 (and __1, __2, ...) environment variable(s) MUST actually be set on the Render service itself, to the real deployed frontend origin(s) (e.g. https://crm.daftech.et). If that env var is missing, CORS silently falls through to appsettings.json's localhost:4200 default and every browser request from the real frontend will fail.

Jwt._comment: SigningKey MUST be overridden with the Jwt__SigningKey environment variable (generate with: openssl rand -base64 48). The app refuses to start without one at least 32 bytes long.

Email._comment: Provider = Smtp or BrevoApi. Render's free tier blocks outbound SMTP ports (25/465/587) — use BrevoApi there. Override with Email__Provider env var.

Smtp._comment: Only used when Email:Provider = Smtp. Override Host/Username/Password with Smtp__Host / Smtp__Username / Smtp__Password environment variables.

BrevoApi._comment: Only used when Email:Provider = BrevoApi. Override ApiKey with BrevoApi__ApiKey environment variable — get it from Brevo's SMTP & API > API Keys tab (not the SMTP tab).

Storage._comment: Provider = LocalFileSystem, Cloudinary, or Postgres. Render's free/hobby tier has no persistent disk — the container filesystem is wiped on every redeploy — so LocalFileSystem loses files there. Postgres stores file bytes in this app's own database (stored_files table) so uploads survive redeploys with no third-party dependency. Override with Storage__Provider env var.

Cloudinary._comment: Only used when Storage:Provider = Cloudinary. Get CloudName/ApiKey/ApiSecret from the free-tier account dashboard at cloudinary.com/console. Override with Cloudinary__CloudName / Cloudinary__ApiKey / Cloudinary__ApiSecret environment variables — never commit real values here.
